responsibility: Provides shared support code for tree streaming used by both LTO readers and writers. It maintains the machine-mode translation table, verifies that all tree structure variants are handled by the streamer, implements the tree cache that maps shared tree nodes to stream indices and back, and preloads canonical global/common tree nodes so they need not be redundantly serialized.
same_name_distinction: Implements shared tree-streaming support used by both LTO input and output, such as machine-mode table handling, streamer coverage checks, tree-cache management, and preloading canonical common nodes. Unlike the header, this file supplies the common runtime logic rather than the type/API declarations.
